items.exampleEn: The new board game is fiendishly clever.
items.exampleZh: 這款新桌遊設計得巧妙極了。

items.exampleEn: He explained the rules tediously, one by one, for an hour.
items.exampleZh: 他花了一個小時，冗長乏味地把規則一條一條講完。

items.exampleEn: Lying to a close friend is a detestable act.
items.exampleZh: 對好朋友說謊是很可惡的行為。

items.exampleEn: The old boat moved sedately down the river.
items.exampleZh: 那艘老船從容緩慢地順河而下。

items.exampleEn: It was such an engrossing book that I forgot to sleep.
items.exampleZh: 那本書太引人入勝了，我連覺都忘了睡。

items.exampleEn: The letter was written impersonally, without even using my name.
items.exampleZh: 那封信寫得冷冰冰的，連我的名字都沒用。
items.glossZh: 冷淡地；不帶個人感情地

items.exampleEn: He smiled unconvincingly and said he was fine.
items.exampleZh: 他勉強笑了笑，說自己沒事，但看起來不太可信。

items.exampleEn: The sun beat down remorselessly on the dry fields.
items.exampleZh: 太陽毫不留情地曬著乾旱的田地。

items.sentenceEn: The meeting went on tediously for three hours without any decision.
items.sentenceZh: 會議冗長乏味地開了三個小時，什麼也沒決定。

items.audioEn: The customer service agent answered impersonally, reading the same rules again and again.
items.audioZh: 客服人員冷冰冰地回答，一遍又一遍地唸著同樣的規定。
options: In a cold way, just repeating the rules.

items.sentenceEn: The documentary was so engrossing that nobody left early.
items.sentenceZh: 那部紀錄片太吸引人了，沒有人提早離開。

items.sentenceEn: The guests sat sedately at the long table, waiting for the speeches.
items.sentenceZh: 賓客們從容地坐在長桌旁，等著聽致詞。

items.stemEn: The questions came ____, one after another, until he gave up.
items.stemZh: 問題一個接一個毫不停歇地丟過來，直到他放棄為止。

items.stemEn: Bullying is ____, and our school will not accept it.
items.stemZh: 霸凌是可憎的行為，我們學校絕不容許。

items.passageEn: Last spring I took an online history course. The first lectures were tediously long, and the professor spoke impersonally, as if he were reading from a script. The weekly tests were fiendishly hard, and the deadlines came remorselessly, one after another. Then a guest lecturer took over for a month. Her insightful stories about life in ancient cities were engrossing, and she moved sedately through each topic, never rushing. One student argued, rather unconvincingly, that the course was still too difficult. I disagreed. In my view, the rude comments that some students posted on the course website were far more detestable than any test.
items.passageZh: 去年春天，我修了一門線上歷史課。前幾堂課冗長乏味，教授說話冷冰冰的，好像在照著稿子唸。每週的測驗難得要命，作業截止日期一個接一個，毫不停歇。後來一位客座講師接手了一個月。她講古代城市生活的故事很有見地、引人入勝，而且每個主題都從容地慢慢講，從不趕進度。有位同學說這門課還是太難，但說得不太有說服力。我不同意。在我看來，有些學生在課程網站上的無禮留言，比任何測驗都可惡得多。

questions.questionZh: 作者認為什麼比測驗更可惡？
options: 教授每次上課都照著稿子唸完
客座講師講到古代城市的故事
有些學生在網站上留的話

items.promptZh: 他解釋自己為什麼遲到，但說得不太有說服力。
referenceEn: He explained, rather unconvincingly, why he was late.
He explained why he was late, but he did it unconvincingly.
rubricZh: 「不太有說服力地」用副詞 unconvincingly（可加 rather、a little 等）
「為什麼遲到」可寫，例如 why he was late、the reason he was late 等
說的是已發生的事，時態配合內容（例如 explained、was）

items.promptZh: 那隻大烏龜從容地爬過馬路。
referenceEn: The large turtle crossed the road sedately.
The big turtle made its way sedately across the road.
rubricZh: 「從容緩慢地」用 sedately（例如 crossed the road sedately 等）
「爬過馬路」可寫，例如 crossed the road、made its way across the road 等
時態配合內容；過去式、現在完成式都正確
